Single-Case Design

Source: vignettes/single-case-design.Rmd
single-case-design.Rmd

This guide shows a minimal call to run_scd_analysis().

Data

Use one row per observation, with columns for case, time, phase, and outcome. The following data are simulated.

library(scdbayes)

data <- simulate_scd_data(n_cases = 3, n_phase_a = 5, n_phase_b = 5,
                          effect_size = 1)
head(data[, c("case", "time", "phase", "outcome")], 4)
#>   case time phase  outcome
#> 1   C1    1     A 55.20589
#> 2   C1    2     A 39.20309
#> 3   C1    3     A 51.39238
#> 4   C1    4     A 49.15251

Fit a model 

result <- run_scd_analysis(data, options = list(family = "gaussian"))
result$diagnostics

Model fitting requires Stan and can take time. The result contains the fitted model, summaries, and diagnostics. Inspect diagnostics before interpreting results. See ?run_scd_analysis for arguments.
